title: Explore the Payments Default View
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Payments separates settlements, submissions, sales/credits, adjustments, statements and reports; additional options include authorizations. Newly enrolled users may wait four hours for payments data.
limitations: Public description only; live enrollment and entitlement not tested. Four hours is not an Etail SLA.

title: Viewing Your Settlements
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Pending/posted settlements expand into net amounts, deductions, paid-to-bank amounts and transaction details, with CSV/XLS/PDF exports.
limitations: No internal accounting schema, bank confirmation protocol or settlement SLA is exposed.

title: Viewing Your Submissions
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Submission rows include invoice/settlement references, charges, credits, deductions, amounts, transaction counts and separate payee/submitter merchant and location identifiers.
limitations: Display fields do not prove one-to-one underlying relationships or an export/API schema.

title: Searching, Filtering, and Downloading Submissions
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Search by submission invoice, amount bounds/type, date type/range and location. Payee and submitter filters differ; download choices can adjust filters.
limitations: Date/timezone boundary semantics and backend query authorization are not documented here.

title: Viewing Transaction Details of Submissions
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Submission expansion displays settlement/submission identifiers and amounts; additional detail includes activity, transaction counts, fees and credits.
limitations: Progressive disclosure is documented; database or network event structure is not.

title: Viewing Transactions
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Transactions can be filtered by location/date, displayed with configurable columns and downloaded as CSV/XLS/PDF.
limitations: No complete transaction field dictionary, mobile behavior or API was validated.

title: Navigating Adjustments and Chargebacks
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Adjustments and chargebacks use separate tables/settings. Related dispute information is linked for users enrolled in Disputes.
limitations: Enrollment is not a complete account/role authorization specification.

title: Search, Filter, and Download Adjustments and Chargebacks
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Adjustment lookup supports references, amounts, dates and locations, including payee/submitter filters; downloadable results are available.
limitations: The source also lists card-number lookup; Etail explicitly must not collect/store raw card details.

title: Downloading E-Statements
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Merchant-specific statements support category, monthly/annual period and PDF/XLS format. New enrollment begins statement availability the following month.
limitations: Availability behavior is not an Etail retention or statement-generation requirement.

title: Downloading Reports
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Reports configure grouping, detail, format, locations, range and settlement/transaction/Amex date basis; named templates can be saved and reused.
limitations: Amex Date semantics, timezone and report internals are not defined on this page.

title: Report Library
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: A report library shows scheduled and monthly scheduled downloads under Statements and Reports.
limitations: Retry behavior, job status enum, retention and scheduling guarantees are not specified.

title: How to use the Disputes Summary Table
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; Dispute Alert requires Accelerated Dispute Resolution enrollment; publication date unstated.
evidence: Response Needed, Review in Progress and Closed views; expiration priority; inquiry and chargeback differ in debit timing. Bulk response partitions mixed case types. Downloads include columns beyond those displayed.
limitations: Partial program coverage; not an internal case-state or security model. Export columns must still obey Etail authorization.

title: Managing a Dispute Case
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Case detail shows response deadline, next action, reason/code, amounts and history; reply choices distinguish agreeing from disagreement or prior refund.
limitations: Case-specific deadlines and outcome decision rules are not publicly enumerated here.

title: Disagreeing with a Card Member claim with an option for partial refund
scope: U.S. Merchant website dispute response; partial refund option documented for inquiries; publication date unstated.
evidence: Contest with reason, evidence, comments and attestation. The partial refund option supports a specified amount or percentage and applies to inquiries.
limitations: Do not generalize this option to chargebacks, every refund API or every jurisdiction.

title: Agreeing with the Card Member claim and issuing a full refund
scope: U.S. Merchant website dispute response; publication date unstated.
evidence: The accepting response chooses Amex-issued chargeback or direct credit, with comments and initials before submission.
limitations: The page does not establish financial completion on form submission or explain duplicate-refund reconciliation.

title: Adding Documents to a Case
scope: U.S. Merchant website; open cases after response; publication date unstated.
evidence: Additional evidence can be submitted while a case remains open; published type/size/page limits apply and document-processing errors appear above the main queue.
limitations: Limits are program behavior, not universal; virus-scanning and storage implementation remain unknown.

title: Reviewing Closed Disputes
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Closed cases remain filterable/exportable; win/loss reports use separate date selection and a limited report history.
limitations: UI report-history limits are not proof of financial or legal record retention.

title: Searching for Disputes
scope: U.S. Merchant website; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Search supports case and charge references or cardholder identifiers, then opens the selected case for status/action.
limitations: Etail will use safe scoped identifiers; no permission for raw card details is inferred.

title: View and Update Your Account
scope: U.S. Merchant website; single/multiple Merchant ID variants; publication date unstated.
evidence: Primary merchant rows expand to linked locations while standalone IDs remain separate. Legal name and tax ID are view-only in the described editor.
limitations: Not an authorization model or a complete legal-entity change workflow. No real sensitive information was accessed.

title: Edit Bank Information
scope: U.S. Merchant website; single/multiple Merchant ID variants; publication date unstated.
evidence: Select credit/debit accounts, complete one-time-code identity verification, enter new information and confirm the change.
limitations: Bank ownership verification, effective time, approval conditions and in-flight payment routing are unspecified; sandbox accepts no real bank details.

title: Create a New Merchant ID
scope: U.S. Merchant website; existing accounts eligible for online merchant-ID creation; publication date unstated.
evidence: Saved progress, relationship selection, business/ownership/financial review, central versus individual pay, and a final request acknowledgment. Franchise-related paths require support.
limitations: Does not imply unrestricted new-merchant approval, permission to collect real KYB data or applicability to OptBlue. Private decision criteria unavailable.

title: Create Multiple New Merchant IDs
scope: U.S. Merchant website; headquarters batch creation; publication date unstated.
evidence: Batch creation inherits headquarters information while allowing selected business, financial, contact, ownership and signer sections to be reviewed per location.
limitations: Partial failure, duplicate handling, approval and transaction semantics are not published.

title: View Account Updates
scope: U.S. Merchant website; single/multiple Merchant ID variants; publication date unstated.
evidence: Chronological change attempts show merchant, date, change type/activity and success/failure/pending state; an attempt opens into more detail.
limitations: No full approval, retry, audit immutability or internal event-state specification is exposed.

title: Online Account: View/Edit Contact Information and Alerts
scope: U.S. Merchant website user profile; enrollment-specific notifications; publication date unstated.
evidence: Contact changes require identity checks; payment, dispute and marketing subscriptions are distinct, with alternate destinations supported for some alerts.
limitations: Do not copy legacy security-code design or opt-in defaults into Etail without its own security/consent decisions.

title: Manage Locations
scope: U.S. Merchant website profile; public help page; publication date unstated.
evidence: Locations display enrolled Payments/Disputes/Account Updates experiences; an existing accepting location can be added; a user-list report audits access to merchant IDs.
limitations: Enrollment input requirements are not sufficient evidence of backend authorization or ownership verification.

title: Merchant Site Terms of Use, section 6 Access Levels
scope: U.S. Merchant Site; PDF dated 2025-10-31; sections 5-6 read for user/access behavior.
evidence: Distinct user roles and access levels constrain feature access, with a dispute-only example; separate users are expected to have individual credentials.
limitations: Terms are program-specific and mutable. This is product-reference research, not an interpretation of Etail legal obligations.

title: OptBlue merchant acceptance overview
scope: U.S. OptBlue public overview; current page read 2026-09-08; eligibility differs by market/category.
evidence: Participating providers contract with eligible merchants, set rates and combine statement/deposit/servicing; certified channels can include PayFac relationships.
limitations: No Etail approval or provider entitlement established. Current merchant-volume text differs from dated M28; figures are not imported.

title: Payment Facilitator Acceptance of American Express Cards
scope: U.S. factsheet dated October 2024, with Puerto Rico/U.S. Virgin Islands qualifications; both pages read.
evidence: PayFac is described as merchant of record receiving settlement for program merchants; registration and transaction-data specifications run through a certified OptBlue participant.
limitations: Dated eligibility figures conflict with the current overview. A commercial factsheet is not an approved program/API implementation contract.

title: Integrated Payments Providers Program
scope: Global Network public program overview; publication date unstated; product/market availability requires verification.
evidence: Provider program supports specification guidance and certification for POS, e-commerce and host functions; registration includes NDA and terms.
limitations: No private specifications accessed, no agreement accepted, no certification or production entitlement established.

title: American Express Merchant Website Support Center
scope: U.S. Merchant support; public index and support availability read; publication date unstated.
evidence: Help is organized by registration, account, payments and disputes. Authenticated chat and phone support are distinct channels with stated service hours.
limitations: Support staff tooling, escalation rules, staffing and resolution SLAs are not publicly revealed or tested.
